# apple_subscriptions (Data Source)

Lists the subscriptions of a subscription group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_subscriptions" "pro" {
  subscription_group_id = apple_subscription_group.pro.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group.

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) The subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.
- `name` (String) Reference name.
- `period` (String) Subscription period.
- `product_id` (String) Product ID.
- `state` (String) State.
